## 216. Shepherd Productivity

- ID: 216

- Purpose: Amount of food collected from sheep multiplier

- Default Values:

    - 1:  Default
    - 1.57:  Tatars

- Note: Since this works by multiplying the amount of resources gathered by a villager, it has a side effect of increasing the gather rate. In the case of Tatars, This is compensated for by reducing villager work rate by 57%

## 57. Dead Unit ID

 - ID: 57

 - This is the ID of the unit to spawn after the current unit dies. This is whats used to make the dismounted konniks possible

verifiedClaims.resource216: Amount of food collected from sheep multiplier; changes gather productivity, not merely a dead-animal storage scalar
verifiedClaims.task216: Actual raw task110 for male592/female590 has food0→food0 and resource_multiplier216, WorkValue1=1
verifiedClaims.deadUnit57: Attribute57 changes unit spawned after current unit dies
verifiedClaims.newTC: Same-version civ text says new TCs spawn2sheep from Castle; raw annex/death chain captured rather than inventing Type7

boundaries: Public guide's prose 'reducing ... by57%' is mathematically imprecise; authoritative raw operation is multiplier0.637, not subtract57%.
Resource nodes never deplete in current model. Existing extra-food total and new-TC sheep-entity availability are explicitly not simulated; do not add Food stock grants or villagers.
Independent realCost outputs need actual baseline read; do not assume existing warning from UNHANDLED_RES import.
